records.title: Unmasking Users in IoC: LLMs, Text Profiling, and Privacy Implications
records.reason: The Springer full text studies text-based user profiling and privacy implications in cloud/IoC deployments using authorship/depression datasets. The LLM use is an application for profiling, not a model inference efficiency or serving contribution.

records.title: Exploration-Driven Optimization for Test-Time Large Language Model Reasoning
records.reason: EDO is an RL post-training objective that promotes response diversity and improves the quality of test-time scaling (self-consistency/BoN/tree search). The paper does not reduce test-time compute or resource use; its stated gains are accuracy under added inference-time sampling, so it is outside the efficiency target.

records.title: BROS: Bias-Corrected Randomized Subspaces for Memory-Efficient Single-Loop Bilevel Optimization
records.reason: BROS is a memory-efficient single-loop bilevel optimization method for training/hyperparameter learning. Its memory savings apply to optimization/backpropagation, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: PowerStep: Memory-Efficient Adaptive Optimization via ℓp-Norm Steepest Descent
records.reason: PowerStep reduces optimizer-state memory during model training by replacing second-moment statistics with a single momentum buffer; the paper reports training-memory/throughput tradeoffs. It does not optimize inference or serving.

records.title: AdaPaD: Adaptive Parallel Deflation for PEFT with Self-Correcting Rank Discovery
records.reason: AdaPaD is a parallel deflation algorithm for training PEFT adapters and discovering LoRA ranks. Its reported parameter-budget and adapter-size improvements concern training/adaptation, with no measured base-model inference or serving benefit.
